notes_for_editor: Only the Eastern US Forest Lookouts index places a lookout here. A 2016 Florida tower list held in the crawl cache, whose source has no stable URL and so is not cited, gives a lowercase 'blackwater' entry at 30.74192, -86.83286 in Santa Rosa County, about 6 m from the record's point; its height-like number (172) is not used. The sources do not establish whether the lookout is inside Blackwater River State Forest, so the story does not say so. No NHLR, FFLOS or Florida Forest Service record was reachable. Build date, agency, height, staffing and current condition are unknown. The map position the story cites is an embedded map point in the page HTML at 30.7419, -86.8328 (zoom 10); it is not in the visible text, so it has no quote in evidence. The story now says only that the forest's name begins with the lookout's name, not that the two are the same.
